name: かいもとえさと/かいり
description: 創作アカウントです。 主にマンガやイラスト。 2022~ 片隅でソシャゲのイラストやip案件、商業イラスト描いてる人です

works.body:
Hello! I love your art!

I would like to request Luo Xiaohei from 羅小黑戰記 (white haired version) with the cat version!  I am the English voice for Hei and would like to use it for autographs at events. Is it possible for the image to be 2400x3000?

Composition is up to you, but expression I would like energetic!! If possible, a background in nature would be wonderful. Thank you!!
